items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe, and it’s a pleasure today to have Don Wolff... down here in Sarasota, Florida

ctx.x: Don Wolff has become one of the leading authorities of jazz on film. A lawyer by trade, his love of jazz has led to a weekly radio show for KMOX that covers most of the country every Saturday. Don has amassed one of the largest collections of jazz on film in the U.S. He is a frequent guest at festivals and jazz parties where he shares his film clips and considerable knowledge about jazz personalities and the history of this American art form.
Don was interviewed by Monk Rowe at the Sarasota Jazz Festival on April 13,

We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe, and it’s a pleasure today to have Don Wolff, producer of a great radio series for KMOX, down here in Sarasota, Florida, and general keeper of the jazz flame. And I’m really interested how this all came about and that presentation you gave on Basie was really marvelous.
